tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the official DropFlow documentation. Use 1-3 keywords, for example "scroll animation" or "mobile layout". Returns matching docs with their id, section, URL and a short excerpt; read one in full with get_doc. Leave the query out to get the whole table of contents.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read one DropFlow doc in full, as plain text, by the id from search_docs.

tools.name: list_library
tools.description: List ready-made DropFlow Library blocks (sections and pages), optionally filtered by keywords and a category slug. Returns slugs, names, categories and design themes, plus every category with its count. Get one block's details and preview image with get_library_block.

tools.name: get_library_block
tools.description: Details of one DropFlow Library block by slug: description, category, theme, the DropFlow version it needs, what it contains, and its preview image URL.

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.description: The latest DropFlow version and what changed in recent releases, newest first.
